native_v1: Pinned upstream score_exact comparator used during the frozen 100-task Harbor cohort.
adapter_v2_change: Before calling the pinned scorer, flatten prediction and reference lists and canonicalize a prediction slot to the reference representation only when both parse as Decimal values and are mathematically equal. List length, slot order, text semantics, and all unequal values are unchanged.
reason: The pre-outcome full-population parser-equivalence audit found 22/181 false negatives for exact Decimal-equivalent answer representations.
audit_scope: Synthetic parser/list-equivalence cases over all 142 image-bearing CAL tasks. These cases establish comparator behavior conditional on the released references; they do not independently establish the scientific correctness of source labels.
cohort_regrading: All 100 retained answer artifacts must be regraded under native-v1 and adapter-v2. No selective regrading, task reruns, or instruction changes are permitted. Native-v1 remains the precommitted headline accuracy.
